title: Kevin Stout’s CV
text:
Mathematics Student

kevinjstout975@pdc.k12.wi.us | (608) 306-0468




Pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Mathematics at Brigham Young University - Idaho.




Sept 2024 - Apr 2028 Brigham Young University - Idaho

GPA: 4.0 (Freshman)
Notable Coursework: Multivariable Calculus, Linear Algebra
Currently Enrolled: Differential Equations w/ Lin Alg, Introduction to Analysis

Sept 2020 - May 2024 Prairie du Chien High School

Salutatorian
GPA: 4.46 (Weighted) | 4.00 (Unweighted)
ACT: 34
AP Scholar with Distinction: AP Calculus BC (5), AP Statistics (5)





Jan 2025 - Present BYU-Idaho Math Tutoring Center | Rexburg, ID

Facilitate learning in the on-campus math lab, assisting students with homework and exam preparation.
Provide one-on-one tutoring for mathematics courses ranging from arithmetic through calculus.

Feb 2021 - Aug 2024 Library Page | Prairie du Chien Memorial Library, WI

Managed online catalog systems, including withdrawing media, retrieving information, and editing data.
Coordinated the planning and preparation for over 25 public events and programs.
Developed leadership and intrapersonal skills through hands-on practice in a dynamic work environment.





Fall 2023 - 2024 Math Teacher’s Assistant | High School

Supported two middle school math classes as a general teacher’s aid.
Gained insight into pedagogy by working with both cooperative and uncooperative student profiles.

Summer 2024 Sunday School President and Teacher

Prepared and delivered bi-weekly lessons on various topics to adult groups.
Utilized lesson manuals and scriptures to facilitate engaging group discussions.





2024 First Place, BYU-Idaho Integration Bee
2024 Eagle Scout, Boy Scouts of America

Kiwanis Hall of Fame: Excellence in Mathematics & Language (Chinese).
John Philip Sousa Award: Recipient for musical excellence.
State Music Medals: Received “Star 1” ratings in senior year for Flute Solo and Vocal Jazz Group performance.






Eagle Scout Project: Prepared lessons and taught the Chess merit badge.
Community Service: Flood assistance (sandbagging/cleanup) and online record transcription.
Involvement: National Honors Society, Student Council, and Church Service.
